dedupe_keys.name: banca dati prove geognostiche parametri sismici linee

description: Banca dati prove geognostiche - Parametri sismici (linee) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappegis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. Vector-type georeferenced database, in linear form, containing seismic geognostic surveys for which the main geophysical parameters acquired during the test were measured. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Geognostic evidence database - Seismic parameters (lines)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 5 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
